title: sida rhombifolia subsp. alnifolia
intro: Sida rhombifolia subsp. alnifolia, commonly known as the Malabar mallow or Chinese jute, is a plant species in the mallow family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Sida rhombifolia subsp. alnifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
